summary: This task's own workspace/branch has zero commits ahead of master (a genuine no-op by design), because its actual scope was to fix two reviewer-rejected issues on the already-open PR #44 (branch worker/task-20260724-135839-phase4-architecture-judgment-domains-dep), which it did via commit 3253a21 pushed to that branch. The code fix in ai-os-scripts/audit_pipeline_architecture.py correctly resolves the reported bug: upsert_findings() now tracks and returns the actual set of finding_ids inserted for the first time (new_finding_ids), and main() computes each per-repo/per-domain new_findings count by intersecting that repo's domain_records against new_finding_ids, replacing the previous logic (sum(1 for r in domain_records)) that was mathematically identical to len(domain_records) and thus always equal to total_findings -- a real, previously-flagged bug. The accompanying AUDITOR_ENGINE_PHASE_PLAN_2026-07-24.yaml edit replaces a false self-reported 'every pipeline re-run confirmed idempotent' narrative with an honest description of the bug, the fix, and concrete reproduced evidence (two real back-to-back run_ids with actual queried audit_runs total_findings/new_findings values). The diff is small, additive/corrective, touches no migrations, schema, auth, payment, billing, rls, security, .env, or .github/workflows paths, and is well within tier1 scope. No security or architectural concerns found.
